data.name: ConfigFlow.Token.Description
data.value: Macro Deck uses your personal CountTogether API token to show and change your counters.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Token.Instruction
data.value: Open the CountTogether app, go to Settings, API Token and tap Show API token. Copy the token and paste it below.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Token.Field.Description
data.value: Anyone with this token can read and change your counters. Rotate it in the app if it leaks.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Errors.Rejected
data.value: CountTogether rejected this API token. Check that it is complete and has not been rotated.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Errors.Unreachable
data.value: CountTogether could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.

data.name: Issues.TokenRejected.Description
data.value: CountTogether no longer accepts the saved API token, for example because it was rotated in the app. Enter the current token.

data.name: Actions.Increment.Description
data.value: Increases a regular counter by its step size or by a custom amount.

data.name: Actions.Decrement.Description
data.value: Decreases a regular counter by its step size or by a custom amount.

data.name: Actions.Parameters.Amount.Description
data.value: Leave empty to use the step size of the counter.

data.name: Errors.NotConfigured
data.value: Set up the CountTogether integration first.

data.name: Errors.NotConnected
data.value: Macro Deck is not connected to CountTogether right now.

data.name: Errors.TokenRejected
data.value: CountTogether rejected the API token. Enter the current token in the CountTogether integration.

data.name: Errors.CounterNotFound
data.value: This counter no longer exists or you no longer have access to it.

data.name: Errors.PermissionDenied
data.value: You are not allowed to change this counter.

data.name: Errors.RateLimited
data.value: CountTogether received too many requests. Try again in a moment.

data.name: Errors.Timeout
data.value: CountTogether did not answer in time.

data.name: Errors.Failed
data.value: The counter could not be changed.

data.name: Errors.NotUpDown
data.value: Only regular counters can be incremented or decremented, date counters change by themselves.

data.name: Errors.InvalidAmount
data.value: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000000.

data.name: Variables.Counter.Description
data.value: Current value of this CountTogether counter. Date counters report days.

data.name: Events.ValueChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when the value of a counter changes, in Macro Deck, in the app or for a shared counter by someone else.

data.name: Events.Deleted.Description
data.value: Fires when a counter is deleted or you lose access to it.

data.name: Events.Parameters.Counter.Description
data.value: Only react to this counter. Leave empty to react to every counter.

data.name: Widgets.Counter.Description
data.value: Shows the current value of a CountTogether counter.

data.name: Widgets.CounterButtons.Description
data.value: Shows a regular counter with buttons to increment and decrement it.

data.name: Widgets.Config.Counter.Description
data.value: Your counters appear here once the CountTogether integration is connected.

data.name: Widgets.State.NotConfigured.Hint
data.value: Edit this widget to choose a counter.

data.name: Widgets.State.NotSetUp.Hint
data.value: Set up the CountTogether integration in Macro Deck.

data.name: Widgets.State.TokenRejected.Hint
data.value: Enter the current token in the CountTogether integration.

data.name: Widgets.State.Unavailable.Hint
data.value: It was deleted or you lost access to it.
